corrections.reason: Both the 2nd-person plural verb morphology in Mark 11:5 (matching ትገብሩ) and the visible right-side vowel stroke on the final Fidel confirm ዘትፈትሑ followed by a single punctuation dot.
The canonical Ge'ez text of Mark 11:7 and the printed glyphs on the page clearly read ወደይኑ ('and they laid/put their garments upon it'), where ደይ was visually misread as ረኃ.
